notes.title: 🚗 Drive Thru Game Playtest Now Live! 🚗
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to announce the release of our Drive Thru game playtest! 🎉 This is your chance to dive into the world of fast-paced drive-thru management, where you’ll take orders, prepare delicious meals, and serve customers efficiently.

Why Participate?

Shape the Game: Your feedback is crucial in helping us improve and refine the game.
Exclusive Access: Be among the first to experience new features and updates.
Community Involvement: Join a community of passionate gamers and share your thoughts and ideas.

Provide Feedback: Share your thoughts, suggestions, and any bugs you encounter through our feedback form steam community or our discord.

We can’t wait to hear what you think and work together to make Drive Thru the best it can be!

Thank you for your support and happy gaming! 🎮
